> 第1章 我是谁（第1页）
“月儿...你醒了吗？月儿...月儿！”
谁？到底是谁在叫我？头好痛...快要裂开的感觉...
映入眼帘的是一个皮肤白皙，但脸部线条却刚毅挺拔，棱角分明，五官中尚有些稚嫩，显然脸部的主人还只是个未长开的少年。
他双手抓紧着自己的肩膀，眼神急切，眼中的关怀不似有假，但有时却有些犹豫的闪躲，分不清眼前的少年是敌是友。
“月儿？你是在叫我吗？我叫月儿？”
床上的女孩面部肌肤吹弹可破，伴有一点点婴儿肥，嫩似能掐出水来，加上那一双水灵的大眼睛，正在好奇的打量着他，让他心中不由得一软。
“你...你不记得了？月儿，你不记得了？”
他死死地抓着她的手臂，盯着她迷茫的眼睛，生怕漏掉她眼神的一丝细节，似是要看穿她有无撒谎心虚的痕迹。
女孩见状沉思了良久，脑袋里却还是一片空白。
我是谁？从她空荡荡的脑海里真的找不出答案，转而朝他投去疑惑的目光，眼底一片清澈。
见她反应不似有假，少年呆愣片刻，嘴中不停地在喃喃自语。
“看来是真的...你果然忘记了...忘记了也好..也好...”
见少年发愣似的自言自语，她心中更是疑惑。
反手抓着他的手臂摇了摇，急切的问道：“你在自言自语什么呢？你还没告诉我，我到底是谁？我为什么会在这里？你又是谁？”
少年回过神来，看着她疑惑的小眼神，不禁唏嘘地抚着她的头道：“你叫白月，是一个孤儿，以前的事，你不记得也罢，都不是什么好的回忆，忘记对你来说也是一件好事。”
“至于我...呵呵，不过一个普通朋友罢了。”
见床上的小不点虽听着点点头，眼底却充满着戒备与疑惑。
“你可以叫我云风。我知道来到这个世界你对一切都很陌生很警惕，但我想对你说的是，你可以信任我，无论如何，我都不会愿意去伤害你。”

“当然，话我就是这么说，信不信就在于你。”
白月思来想去，自己就一个小孩子的身体，也忘却了过往的种种，于他而言，真的没有什么好的利用价值。
卸下了心防，再回顾周遭的环境，白月才发现他们竟然是在一间破旧的房屋内，而她所盖着的被褥也是旧得不行。
见她一脸错愕的模样，少年脸一红，神情十分的羞涩。
“这里是我找到的一间被废弃的居所，目前我身上还没有钱，就先将就着住下吧，以后我们赚到钱了再搬家。现在，你的主要任务就是好好的活着，好好的生活，好吗月儿？”
他目光灼热的看向她，认真的语气所表述的一番话语，完全不似一个十五岁的少年对一个五岁的女孩所说的。
虽不明他语言中的含义，但白月还是应下了。
白月发现了现在最主要的问题，好像是他们都很穷啊喂！
“那啥...就，要不先捡点瓶瓶罐罐什么的换点钱？”

> Chapter 1 Who am I (Page 1)
"Yue'er... are you awake? Yue'er... Yue'er!"
Who? Who is calling me? My head hurts so much... It feels like it's about to burst...
What came into view was a man with fair skin, but strong and straight facial lines, sharp edges and corners, and facial features that were still a little immature. It was obvious that the owner of the face was still a young man who had not yet grown up.
He grasped his shoulders with both hands, his eyes were eager, and the concern in his eyes did not seem to be fake, but sometimes he hesitated to dodge, unable to tell whether the young man in front of him was a friend or an enemy.
"Yue'er? Are you calling me? My name is Yue'er?"
The girl on the bed had skin that could be broken by blowing, with a little bit of baby fat, and was so tender that it looked like water could be squeezed out. Plus, her big, watery eyes were looking at him curiously, which made him feel soft in his heart.
"You...you don't remember? Yue'er, you don't remember?"
He held her arm tightly and stared into her confused eyes, fearing that he would miss any detail in her eyes, as if he wanted to see if she had any trace of a guilty conscience in lying.
The girl thought for a long time after seeing this, but her mind was still blank.
who I am? She really couldn't find the answer in her empty mind, so she turned to cast a doubtful look at him, her eyes clear.
Seeing that her reaction didn't seem to be false, the young man was stunned for a moment and kept mumbling to himself.
"It seems true...you have indeed forgotten...or you forgot...or..."
Seeing the young man talking to himself as if in a daze, she became even more confused.
She grabbed his arm with her backhand, shook it, and asked eagerly: "What are you talking to yourself about? You haven't told me yet, who am I? Why am I here? Who are you?"
The young man came back to his senses, looked at her doubtful little eyes, and couldn't help but caressed her head and said: "Your name is Bai Yue, you are an orphan. Even if you don't remember the past, it is not a good memory. Forgetting it is also a good thing for you."
"As for me...hehe, I'm just an ordinary friend."
Although he nodded when he saw the little one on the bed, his eyes were full of wariness and doubt.
"You can call me Yunfeng. I know that when you come to this world, you are unfamiliar with everything and are wary of everything, but what I want to say to you is that you can trust me. No matter what, I will not be willing to hurt you."
"Of course, that's what I said. It's up to you to believe it or not."
Bai Yue thought about it, he was just a child's body, and he had forgotten all the past. For him, there really was no good use value.
After taking off her guard and looking back at her surroundings, Bai Yue realized that they were actually in a dilapidated house, and the quilt she was covering herself with was also very old.
Seeing the astonished look on her face, the young man blushed and looked very shy.
"This is an abandoned residence I found. I don't have any money at the moment, so let's live here. We can move again when we make money. Now, your main task is to live well and live well, okay Yue'er?"
He looked at her with burning eyes, and the words he expressed in a serious tone were completely different from what a fifteen-year-old boy would say to a five-year-old girl.
Although Bai Yue didn't understand the meaning of his words, she still agreed.
Bai Yue discovered the main problem now, it seems that they are all poor!
"Well...just, why don't you pick up some bottles and cans in exchange for some money?"
